title: Crisp Tofu Stir-Fry with Ginger-Oyster Sauce
summary: Golden pan-fried tofu is glazed and tossed with carrots, mangetout and pak choi in a glossy ginger and oyster sauce for a quick, colourful stir-fry.

ingredients.item: vegetable stock (check stock label for celery)
vegetable stock (check stock label for celery)
extra-firm tofu, cut into 24 triangles or 2.5 cm cubes
carrots, peeled and sliced on the diagonal
pak choi, stems and leaves sliced separately

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk the glaze of 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp sugar and 60 ml stock in one bowl and the sauce of 1 tbsp soy sauce, 240 ml stock, 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tsp sesame oil and 1 tbsp cornflour in another, then mix the garlic and ginger with 1 tsp of the oil in a third.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a non-stick frying pan on medium-high, toss the tofu in 40 g cornflour to coat, then fry in one layer until golden on both sides, 4-6 minutes per side.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Pour in the glaze and stir for 1-2 minutes until thick and clinging, then move the tofu to a plate and wipe out the pan.

steps.title: Carrots
steps.text: Heat 1 tsp oil until smoking, brown the carrots for 1-2 minutes, add 120 ml stock, cover for 2-3 minutes until just tender, then uncover until dry and add to the tofu.

steps.title: Greens
steps.text: Heat the last 1 tsp oil, cook the mangetout and pak choi stems for 1-2 minutes, then add the leaves until wilted, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Aromatics
steps.text: Clear the centre of the pan, fry the garlic and ginger mixture for 15-20 seconds, then mix through.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Return the tofu, carrots and sauce to the pan and toss for 2-3 minutes until thickened and glossy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with toasted sesame seeds, if using, and serve at once.

tips: Coat the tofu evenly in cornflour so it fries up properly crisp.
Cook the vegetables in batches so each keeps its own texture rather than stewing together.
Have the sauce and glaze mixed and ready before you start, as the stir-fry comes together quickly.
storage: Best served straight away, though leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 2 days and reheat well in a hot pan. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
